items.headline: Judge denies SEC's request for TRO against LSU in Dec. 3 vote
items.description: A federal judge denied the SEC's request for a temporary restraining order to keep LSU from interfering with a Dec. 3 vote of presidents and chancellors on whether to remove the school from the conference.

items.headline: LSU asks judge to throw out SEC's 'unwarranted' suit against Tigers
items.description: LSU is asking a federal judge to dismiss the SEC's lawsuit against the Tigers, arguing that many of the plaintiffs in the case are protected by sovereign immunity as state officials and that the league doesn't have jurisdiction.
